predictions.written: 2026-09-22, before any layer-response simulation was run
predictions.question: The ring code is built from orders. If the bulk pattern also decomposes into layers, is each layer driven by its own order of the code?

layerBasis.definition: Layer n is the exact discrete harmonic extension H_n of the ring mode cos(n theta): the solution of the 4-neighbour discrete Laplace equation on the 81 interior cells (rows and columns 1 to 9) with Dirichlet data cos(n theta_j) on the 40 ring cells, theta from boundaryCodeUtilities.ringAngles.
layerBasis.decomposition: The interior part of a pattern (or of a response) is fitted by least squares onto H_0..H_7; c_n are the fitted amplitudes and the residual is the part of the response no boundary data could produce, which interior ion-channel currents must have made.
layerBasis.note: Harmonic extensions of the ring's cosine modes span a subspace of the 81-dimensional interior; the residual share is reported alongside every response.

predictions.nullFromPassiveDiffusion: If the interior relaxed as passive diffusion from the held ring, the interior would be the harmonic extension of the ring's values. Perturbing coefficient a_k by epsilon changes the ring by epsilon*cos(k theta), so the interior response would be exactly epsilon*H_k: the response matrix R[n,k] = dc_n/d(a_k) would be diagonal and the residual zero. Every departure from diagonality measures the tissue's departure from passive diffusion.

method.perturbations: Each of a_0..a_3 moved by epsilon in {+-0.005, +-0.015, +-0.05, +-0.15}; the base ring values run from 0.156 to 1.280, so none of these is clipped by the physical range [0, 2]. The three single knockouts (a_k set to 0) are run in the same batch as the large-amplitude case.
method.responseMatrix: R[n,k] = (c_n(perturbed) - c_n(base)) / epsilon, from the interior Vmem at each probe iteration, averaged over the two signs of epsilon.
method.diagonalShare: D_k = |R[k,k]| / sum_n |R[n,k]|, over n = 0..7. Mean D is the mean over the perturbed orders k = 0..3.
method.featureOnsetIteration: The first iteration at which the mean Vmem of the 22 facial-feature cells falls below the hyperpolarized threshold -34.6 mV, for the base code.
method.linearityCheck: R at epsilon = 0.005 and at 0.015 must agree within 10% for the response to count as linear at that moment.

predictions.name: P1 diagonal at small amplitude, early
predictions.claim: Early in the hold, at the smallest epsilon, each order drives mainly its own layer.
predictions.criterion: D_k > 0.5 for every k = 0..3 at iteration 1 and at iteration 8, epsilon = 0.005.

predictions.name: P2 amplitude destroys it
predictions.criterion: Mean D at the last held iteration (300) falls monotonically across epsilon = 0.005, 0.015, 0.05, 0.15.

predictions.name: P3 time destroys it
predictions.claim: Mixing accumulates as the tissue runs.
predictions.criterion: Mean D at epsilon = 0.005 falls monotonically across the probe iterations 1, 8, 64, 300.

predictions.name: P4 no layer structure at the trained moment
predictions.claim: At the knockout amplitude and the moment the face is scored, no layer belongs to any one order.
predictions.criterion: Mean D < 0.5 at iteration 2173 for the knockout-amplitude runs.

predictions.name: P5 mixing precedes the face
predictions.claim: The layers stop being separable before the face's features appear, so the face is not layer-decomposable even though the code is.
predictions.criterion: The first probe iteration at which mean D < 0.5 (knockout amplitude) is at or before the feature-onset iteration.

predictions.name: P6 the interior takes over
predictions.claim: The share of the response that no boundary data could produce grows as the run goes on.
predictions.criterion: The residual share of the response (epsilon = 0.005) at iteration 2173 exceeds its value at iteration 1.

predictions.ifSupported: P1 with P2-P5 would mean layer-order correspondence is real but only in the small, early, diffusive limit, and is gone by the time the face forms: the code's orders and the pattern's layers line up only where the tissue is passive.
predictions.ifP1Fails: If even the smallest, earliest response is off-diagonal, the interior never sorts the code into layers at all, and the layer picture is wrong for this tissue rather than merely outgrown.

shellBasisNote: square-shell cos(n theta) fits, added after the pre-registration as a second basis
